verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant in Obsidian; all AI-related capability mentioned (e.g., Text-Generator plugin) is explicitly a third-party community plugin, not a native feature, and the probe confirms no official vendor MCP server or AI tooling. Community plugins requiring full filesystem access (obsidian-comm-10) are the only AI-adjacent route, but that's an ecosystem extension, not a delegated built-in assistant.
